title: PolicyException
description: Schema representing an approved, expiring waiver for a policy control.

exception_id.description: Unique prefixed identifier for the exception

asset_scope.description: Scope of the exception: specific asset_id or glob pattern

compensating_controls.description: Active compensating controls mitigating the risk

approved_by.description: Identity of the authorized security approver

expires_at.description: Mandatory expiration timestamp (maximum 90 days from grant)
